scope: Procurement-grade school handover portability: open-format data/source-adjacent delivery evidence, detached checksum, exact exported-row verification, isolated restore, audit receipts and acceptance-harness integration

referenceUse.document: User-provided 9-page non-degree education smart-front procurement checklist
referenceUse.policy: Procurement acceptance/delivery reference only; HR01-HR18 domain boundaries remain authoritative
adoptedPatterns: school ownership and reusable structured data handover
database structure, interface documentation and configuration portability
no proprietary-format or supplier-only decryption lock-in

handoverContract.manifest: byte size + SHA-256 for every packaged artifact except manifest.json itself
handoverContract.exactRowEvidence: table_row_counts.csv/json derived from database.sql INSERT lines produced with --skip-extended-insert
handoverContract.restoreTarget: different pre-created empty MySQL database only
handoverContract.fieldEncryptionKeyPolicy: Key IDs in package; required key values transfer separately through a school-controlled secure channel
handoverContract.sourceCodePolicy: matching signed source release is a separate contractual deliverable, never mixed with runtime secrets

dockerComposeRuntime.error: docker command not found in current executor

runtimeGatesStillRequiredBeforeTraffic: run scripts/run_hr_acceptance_gate.py in an isolated Docker/MySQL QA environment
export during an approved maintenance/write-freeze window
create and verify the open handover package plus detached SHA-256
restore into renshi_handover_restore_test and pass exact per-table row counts
migrate --check and schema-count verification on the restored database
start restored web and verify /health/ and /ready/
sample representative HR01-HR18 facts and attachments
verify governed encrypted fields after separate FIELD_ENCRYPTION_KEYS handover

packageVerification.manifestPolicy: ROUND11_FILE_MANIFEST.tsv covers every packaged file except itself
